executiveSummary.headline: Resolve Meetings Facts and Clarify a Strong Expo-Area Proposition
executiveSummary.lead: Sheraton Guadalajara Expo appears in 47.6% of eligible traveler-need scenarios, while AI Consideration is 11.9% and the weighted attribute Reality Gap is 58.0%. These measures do not diagnose a website cause. The immediate verified issue is a public meetings inconsistency: the overview says more than 400 square metres, while the events page reports 12 rooms, 1,654 square metres, and a largest capacity of 500. After sales establishes one approved capacity record, the hotel can present its Expo Guadalajara location, meetings offer, dining, spa, lounge, pool, and pet policy more consistently.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of 252 comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of 63 eligible scenarios where it appeared. Reality Gap is a weighted attribute-recognition diagnostic covering 25 tested attributes. None represents bookings, revenue, rank, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Meetings Facts Need Reconciliation
themes.what: The overview uses a broad statement of more than 400 square metres, while the events page reports 12 rooms, 1,654 square metres, and Diamante capacity of 500.
themes.whyItMatters: Planners and automated systems need one setup-qualified source of truth rather than materially different public figures.

themes.title: Expo and Convention Positioning Is Defensible

themes.whyItMatters: Consistent location and meetings facts can improve buyer context without promising consideration, ranking, or booking gains.

themes.title: Hotel Assets Need Disciplined Presentation
themes.what: MATRIA, QUIDEA Spa, the Platinum-and-above Sheraton Lounge benefit, outdoor pool, and pet policy are buyer-relevant official signals.
themes.whyItMatters: Accurate, maintained descriptions help travelers and planners assess fit; the measured gap does not prove these pages are defective.

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: The overview and events pages use an approved setup-qualified meetings record; Expo Guadalajara, convention, and World Cup context is factual and consistent; MATRIA, QUIDEA Spa, lounge eligibility, pool, and pet facts remain accurate; and Marriott documents whether the observed automated-access behavior is intentional.
executiveSummary.closing: The practical opportunity is disciplined fact control. Resolve the meetings contradiction first, then organize verified Expo-area and on-property strengths into clear buyer context. Future movement should be measured without promising rankings, bookings, or revenue. Digital authority: Expo adjacency is the authority story—not generic directory volume.
